name: irq_handler
comment: ARM IRQ entry (vector 0x18); reads the interrupt source byte from 0xFFFFFE03 and BXes through irq_handler_table (pointer at 0x146b90).

name: irq_handler_table
comment: Per-source interrupt handler pointers; 24/24 valid only under load base 0x18000 (3/24 under base 0).

name: e2e_xor_checksum
comment: VAG MLB XOR checksum, byte 0 skipped. Identical 0x1a-byte body to 0190's 0x14b720.

name: e2e_crc8h2f
comment: AUTOSAR CRC8H2F over bytes 1..n with a per-frame data ID; table at 0x1728a8 (copy 0x1729a8).

name: crc8h2f_table
comment: CRC8H2F lookup table (poly 0x2F); second copy at 0x1729a8.

name: crc8h2f_stackcopy
comment: Second CRC8H2F variant: copies the 256-byte table to the stack and processes ALL bytes (no byte-0 skip) -- not the CAN E2E path; likely a memory/flash integrity check.

name: e2e_tx_crc_D4
comment: TX E2E wrapper, CRC8H2F data ID 0xD4.

name: e2e_tx_crc_AC
comment: TX E2E wrapper, CRC8H2F data ID 0xAC.

name: e2e_tx_xor_AA
comment: TX E2E wrapper, XOR seed 0xAA -> ESP_02 (0x101).

name: e2e_rx_xor_a
comment: RX E2E handler (XOR); one of five. Seed not yet extracted.
